_comment: ACTOR-parity config: 6D_SMPL rotations + SMPL FK (rc + rcxyz + kl). Matches Mathux/ACTOR train_cvae defaults.
_architecture: Transformer encoder + decoder, 8 layers — same as ACTOR README example.
_joints: 24 SMPL joints × 6D rotations (joints 0-23 from 6D_SMPL NPZ; joint 24 zeros dropped).
_losses: rcxyz (position in FK space) + velxyz (temporal structure in FK space) + kl. lambda_rc=0 because the direct 6D MSE loss has a very strong local minimum at the mean gait pose that dominates gradients and causes one-epoch collapse. All learning goes through the FK, which does not have this mean-pose attractor.
_optimiser: AdamW lr=1e-4, wd=1e-4, no scheduler — same as ACTOR.
